notes.title: First Major Update - Oculus and WMR Support!
notes.notes:
Hello defenders of Eldinoor!

We want to thank you for your feedback while we continue to polish the game.  Today marks the first major update to the game since our initial release.

We have introduced support for both Oculus and Windows Mixed Reality headsets.  Thank you to Oculus Start for providing us with a kit.  For our long time players, we've taken some of your feedback in terms of difficulty and tried to address it while maintaining the frantic pace of action.  Additionally, we've tweaked the controls a bit so there should be fewer misclicks when you're trying to build under pressure.

We hope you enjoy the updates!  You can always drop us a line at www.codingjar.com!
